name: goal-system
description: Goal system Cloudflare Pages app with D1-backed Functions.

scripts.build: npm run check && npm test && node scripts/build-pages.mjs
scripts.test: node tests/validation.mjs && node tests/app-smoke.mjs && node --test cloudflare/tests/worker.test.mjs
scripts.check: node --check src/app.js && node --check src/data.js && node --check src/store.js && node --check src/security.js && node --check src/api.js && node --check 'functions/api/[[path]].js' && node --check cloudflare/worker.js
scripts.pages:functions:build: wrangler pages functions build functions --project-directory . --build-output-directory deploy/cloudflare-pages/site --outdir .wrangler/functions-build
